meta.basis: UX4G Design System 3.1 (MIT) foundations; 3D ULPIN v2 design pack tokens.css and design.md; additions for maps, 3D and dark theme

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App and page background: the Studio frame around rails and canvas, the Portal page.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, rails, inspector, cards, dialogs, table body.

tokens.name: surface-subtle
tokens.usage: Table header row, grouped rows, read-only field fill, section bands inside a panel.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Hover wash on rows, list items and map-list entries.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, surface and surface-subtle (14:1 light, 13.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text: table cells, field values, panel copy, on bg, surface and surface-subtle.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata, helper text, timestamps, units, on bg, surface and surface-subtle (at least 5:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and sections. Decorative only, never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Outline of panels, cards and floating map controls.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Border of inputs, checkboxes, radios and segmented controls: at least 3:1 on surface and bg.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Forest green. Primary buttons, active nav and tab, selected geometry, links; as text on surface or primary-soft.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of primary fills and links.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Soft buttons, active tab wash, selected list row, primary badge fill.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill. Never hard-code white: the dark theme uses dark ink on a light green.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus outline, 3px offset, on every surface.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational text and icons; on surface or info-soft.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Informational badge and banner fill.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Reviewed, recorded, valid, check passed; text and icons on surface or success-soft.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Success badge and banner fill.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs review, needs evidence, unresolved, stale; text and icons on surface or warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning badge and banner fill.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Blocking finding, failed import, destructive action; text and icons on surface or danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Danger badge and banner fill.

tokens.name: map-ground
tokens.usage: 3D and 2D map ground plane and the scene background behind it.

tokens.name: map-road
tokens.usage: Road surfaces and carriageways.

tokens.name: map-public-land
tokens.usage: Parks, open space and recorded public land.

tokens.name: map-water
tokens.usage: Water bodies and drains shown as area.

tokens.name: map-parcel-line
tokens.usage: Parcel boundaries: 1px lines, no fill, labels at the centroid.

tokens.name: map-building
tokens.usage: Unselected building massing. Lighting shades walls and roofs from this one value.

tokens.name: map-building-edge
tokens.usage: Edges of massing and floor slabs; 1px.

tokens.name: map-selected
tokens.usage: Fill of the selected building, floor or space when no colour-by mode is on. Always with the map-halo outline.

tokens.name: map-halo
tokens.usage: 2px halo around selection outlines, map labels and pins so they read over any geometry.

tokens.name: sky-band
tokens.usage: Airspace band above ground in the strata section and air-rights envelopes.

tokens.name: soil-top
tokens.usage: Upper soil band in the strata section and underground cut faces.

tokens.name: soil-deep
tokens.usage: Deeper soil band below the first basement.

tokens.name: rights-exclusive
tokens.usage: Colour-by rights: exclusive units (flat, shop, parking bay). Series slot 1; always with a legend and labels.

tokens.name: rights-public
tokens.usage: Colour-by rights: public or authority space (road, metro corridor, utility strata). Series slot 2.

tokens.name: rights-shared
tokens.usage: Colour-by rights: shared or common area (stair, lift, corridor, terrace). Series slot 3.

tokens.name: mark-critical
tokens.usage: Map and chart marks for a blocking finding (overlap volume, clash). Never text; always with an icon and label.

tokens.name: mark-serious
tokens.usage: Map and chart marks for a serious finding.

tokens.name: mark-warning
tokens.usage: Map and chart marks for needs-review items.

tokens.name: mark-good
tokens.usage: Map and chart marks for passed checks.

tokens.name: seq-100
tokens.usage: Readiness ramp, lowest step (continuous maps only).

tokens.name: seq-250
tokens.usage: Readiness ramp; the lightest step allowed for discrete levels on light surfaces.

tokens.name: seq-400
tokens.usage: Readiness ramp, middle.

tokens.name: seq-550
tokens.usage: Readiness ramp, high.

tokens.name: seq-700
tokens.usage: Readiness ramp, highest.

tokens.name: readiness-unknown
tokens.usage: Unknown readiness: grey with a 45 degree hatch. Unknown is never the low end of the ramp.

tokens.name: utility-electric
tokens.usage: Electric lines and ducts (APWA uniform colour code). Utility tubes only, always labelled.

tokens.name: utility-gas
tokens.usage: Gas, oil and steam (APWA).

tokens.name: utility-telecom
tokens.usage: Telecom and signal cables (APWA).

tokens.name: utility-water
tokens.usage: Potable water (APWA).

tokens.name: utility-reclaimed
tokens.usage: Reclaimed water and irrigation (APWA).

tokens.name: utility-sewer
tokens.usage: Sewer and storm drains (APWA).

families.sans: "Noto Sans", "Noto Sans Devanagari", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
families.mono: "Noto Sans Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

groups.name: Studio
groups.note: Officer Studio and Admin: compact, 15px body. Self-hosted in the app (this preview loads Google Fonts); Noto Sans covers Latin and Devanagari.

styles.name: studio-title
styles.usage: Page and record title. One per screen.

styles.name: studio-body
styles.sample: U03 begins at 2.8 m above the benchmark; the plan says 3.0 m.
styles.usage: Default text in rails, inspector and tables.

styles.name: studio-body-sm
styles.usage: Dense table cells, helper text, metadata.

styles.name: studio-label
styles.usage: Field labels, legend labels, badge text. Sentence case, never all caps.

groups.name: Portal
groups.note: Public Portal: the UX4G 3.1 scale. Body never below 16px.

styles.name: portal-body
styles.sample: This record shows released details only. Owner names are not public.

styles.name: portal-body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary text and table cells (UX4G Body/S).

styles.name: body-devanagari
styles.usage: Hindi and other Devanagari text: taller line height for matras (UX4G rule).

groups.name: Data
groups.note: Identifiers, coordinates and measurements that must align or be copied.

styles.name: id-code
styles.usage: 3D ULPIN codes, parcel ULPINs, revision hashes. Selectable, with a copy action.

styles.name: data-num
styles.usage: Coordinates, elevations, areas and volumes in tables and readouts.

spacing.note: 4px base (UX4G sub-grid). 4 to 32 inside screens; 40 to 64 only for Portal page sections.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls, between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related rows, list item padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding, gap between panels in the Studio grid.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Header side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections inside a panel, dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page blocks in Register and Admin.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Portal: between page sections on mobile.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Portal: between page sections on desktop.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Portal: top of home search block.

radius.note: Shape lock: controls 8, panels and cards 12, dialogs and sheets 16, status badges and segmented controls pill, tags and map labels 4.

tokens.name: radius-4
tokens.usage: Tags, map labels, code chips.

tokens.name: radius-8
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, tabs, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-12
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, floating map controls, inspector.

tokens.name: radius-16
tokens.usage: Dialogs, sheets, the Property Card.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status badges, segmented controls, filter chips.

shadow.note: Three elevations tinted with ink, darker in the dark theme. Map controls float with shadow-floating.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Panels and cards at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-floating
tokens.usage: Floating map toolbar, level rail, layer popover, tray.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs, command palette, evidence viewer.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring as box-shadow where an outline would clip (map controls): 3px gap, then 2px focus.

size.note: Layout dimensions of the three surfaces.

tokens.name: header-studio
tokens.usage: Studio and Admin top bar height.

tokens.name: header-portal
tokens.usage: Portal header height, below the 32px accessibility bar.

tokens.name: a11y-bar
tokens.usage: UX4G accessibility bar on every Portal page.

tokens.name: toolbar-height
tokens.usage: Tab rows and panel toolbars.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Studio buttons, inputs, selects.

tokens.name: touch-height
tokens.usage: Portal controls and every touch target.

tokens.name: rail-left
tokens.usage: Studio left rail: layers, spaces list, sources.

tokens.name: rail-right
tokens.usage: Studio inspector.

tokens.name: rail-right-wide
tokens.usage: Inspector with evidence preview or finding compare.

tokens.name: tray-height
tokens.usage: Collapsible bottom tray: import stream and findings list.

tokens.name: dialog-md
tokens.usage: Standard dialog width.

tokens.name: dialog-lg
tokens.usage: Import and export dialogs.

tokens.name: max-content
tokens.usage: Register and Admin content width.

tokens.name: portal-content
tokens.usage: Portal page content width.

opacity.note: Focus and context on the map.

tokens.name: opacity-context
tokens.usage: Everything outside the current selection or isolated floor.

tokens.name: opacity-ghost
tokens.usage: Illustrative geometry and hidden floors: seen, never pickable.

tokens.name: opacity-ground-cut
tokens.usage: Ground plane in underground mode.

zIndex.note: Layer contexts only; never ad-hoc values.

tokens.name: z-canvas
tokens.usage: Map and 3D canvas.

tokens.name: z-map-overlay
tokens.usage: Map toolbar, level rail, legends, coordinate readout.

tokens.name: z-rail
tokens.usage: Left rail and inspector when they overlay the canvas on small screens.

tokens.name: z-tray
tokens.usage: Bottom tray.

tokens.name: z-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, tooltips.

tokens.name: z-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the evidence viewer.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts and live status.
